theme: Lending more to the people who will pay it back
title: Credit Limit Assignment Under a Portfolio Loss Cap
strategies: trivial baseline: give every applicant a fixed moderate tier while the loss cap allows (reproduces the checker baseline)

greedy: assign a limit tier proportional to baseline credit-score percentile, trimming the lowest-score applicants' tiers first if the loss cap is broken -- never consults the per-tier default/utilization response tables

strong: build each applicant's upper concave (loss, profit) envelope across tiers, then bisect a shadow price lambda so 'pick the tier maximizing profit - lambda*loss' per applicant spends the loss cap -- an exchange-argument / Lagrangian-relaxation solution to the underlying multiple-choice knapsack
